project.title: Web Application Security Assessment
project.executiveSummary:
A synthetic test report for validating editable Word output. Three priorities are illustrated.

No client or employer material is included.

findings.title: Cross-account invoice access example 1
findings.description:
Synthetic example only. Unicode: café, Δ, שלום. XML escaping: <tag> & "quoted".

- First observation
- Second observation
findings.reproduction:
GET /api/invoices/1002 HTTP/1.1
Host: example.test
Authorization: Bearer 

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"owner":"account-b"}
findings.impact: An authenticated account could access another account’s data. Synthetic claim only.
findings.recommendation: Enforce object-level authorization and add regression tests.
